# Choose your wedding in the USA or Canada, from Maui to Lake Louise

A destination wedding in the USA runs from Hawaii's beaches to Napa's vines and New York rooftops, and Canada adds the lakes of Banff.
Hawaii is the simplest legal example: no residency rule, and no waiting period once your licence is issued.
Every other state, and each Canadian province, sets its own rules, and we check them for your date and passports.

[Button, primary: Find your destination](#places) [Button, secondary: Speak with a Wedded Advisor](#enquire)

Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance.

Not a wedding? Ask about a Hawaii proposal or honeymoon, a Banff vow renewal or a milestone birthday.

sections.heading: Picture your vows on a Maui beach, in Napa's vines or by Lake Louise
sections.body_md:
## Picture your vows on a Maui beach, in Napa's vines or by Lake Louise

Few regions change this much in one flight. Hawaii gives you beach and lava coast, California gives you vines and cliffs, the Rockies give you lakes and snow, and the South gives you oaks and brass bands.

### Maui and the Big Island
Resort coasts at Wailea, Kaanapali and Kapalua on Maui. On the Big Island, black sand beaches and lava fields meet the sea.

### Lake Louise and Banff
A grand hotel above a lake that freezes in winter, and forest ceremonies in the Rockies.

### Napa and Sonoma
Vineyard ceremonies and long estate dinners as the light drops over the vines.

### Charleston and New Orleans
Avenues of moss-hung live oaks in Charleston. French Quarter courtyards in New Orleans.

### Aspen
A mountain town wedding in summer meadows or in the snow, with the peaks close by.

### New York City
Rooftop skylines, a Central Park portrait and dinner in the city that never needs a backdrop.

**Only here**
- A legal Hawaii marriage with no residency rule and no waiting period once your licence is issued.
- A winter wedding in a grand hotel above a frozen lake.
- A second-line parade walking your guests through New Orleans.

**The feel:** slow gold late afternoons in Hawaii, crisp alpine air at Lake Louise, harvest warmth in wine country.

**Local detail:** in New Orleans, a second line follows the couple out of the ceremony, with a brass band and guests waving handkerchiefs.

## Compare the places couples ask about most
(anchor: #compare)

Ten places, side by side. Style and fit are our planning notes; travel and legal steps are linked to the official rules below.

| Place | Style | Legal steps by passport | Family or adults-only fit | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Maui | Beach resort | Hawaii licence, same steps for US, AU and UK passports | Large family weeks or adults-only resort stays | [Ask about Maui](#enquire) |
| Big Island | Beach and lava coast | Hawaii licence, same steps for US, AU and UK passports | Smaller groups who want space | [Ask about Big Island](#enquire) |
| Kauai | Sea cliffs and gardens | Hawaii licence, same steps for US, AU and UK passports | Intimate weddings and elopements | [Ask about Kauai](#enquire) |
| Napa and Sonoma | Wine country | Rules set by California; we check them for your date | Adults-led dinners; families welcome | [Ask about Napa and Sonoma](#enquire) |
| Big Sur | Coastal cliffs | Rules set by California; we check them for your date | Elopements and small groups | [Ask about Big Sur](#enquire) |
| New York City | City | Rules set by New York State; City Clerk weddings by appointment only | City weekends for any age | [Ask about New York City](#enquire) |
| Aspen | Mountains | Rules set by Colorado; we check them for your date | Families in summer, ski groups in winter | [Ask about Aspen](#enquire) |
| Charleston | Southern charm | Rules set by South Carolina; we check them for your date | Multi-generation family weekends | [Ask about Charleston](#enquire) |
| Las Vegas | City and chapels | Rules set by Nevada; we check them for your date | Couples and small groups | [Ask about Las Vegas](#enquire) |
| Banff and Lake Louise | Mountains and lakes | Rules set by Alberta; we check them for your date | Families in summer, couples in winter | [Ask about Banff and Lake Louise](#enquire) |

Table caption: Style and fit are planning notes, not venue claims. Entry rules for every passport are in "Travel by passport" below.

CMS note: each 'Ask about' link opens the form with Place prefilled (offer=<place>, entry_point=compare-table). No price column and no flights column (no flight-time fact in the ledger).

### Marry legally in Hawaii
(anchor: #hawaii-licence) Last checked October 2026, [Hawaii Department of Health](https://health.hawaii.gov/vitalrecords/marriage-licenses/)

The steps are the same for US, AU and UK passports. There is no state residence or US citizenship requirement, no blood test, and both partners must be 18 or over.
1. Apply online and pay, then meet a State-authorised agent together, in person, with government photo ID. A passport is accepted; proxies are not.
2. Collect the licence no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. There is no waiting period once it is issued, and it is valid for 30 days, in Hawaii only.
3. Your officiant must hold a licence from the State of Hawaii Department of Health.
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F027, Nic] The state fee is USD 65, non-refundable.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Your Wedded Advisor confirms the current state fee before you apply.

### Every other state and province
Each US state and each Canadian province sets its own licence rules. Your Wedded Advisor checks the current steps with the issuing office for your date. In New York City, licences and City Clerk ceremonies are by appointment only, with no walk-ins ([NYC City Clerk](https://www.cityclerk.nyc.gov/content/marriage-license), last checked October 2026). UK citizens: whether you can marry depends on local law, and you may need documents showing you are free to marry ([GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/marriage-abroad/y/usa)).

### Travel by passport
(anchor: #entry) Last checked October 2026
- **US passports:** no travel authorisation for Hawaii or the mainland. For Canada, no tourist visa for stays under 180 days; fly on a passport, as the passport card is not valid for flights ([US State Department](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/international-travel/International-Travel-Country-Information-Pages/Canada.html)).
- **UK passports:** an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, or a visa, before travel to the US, for visits of 90 days or less ([US State Department](https://travel.state.gov/content/travel/en/us-visas/tourism-visit/visa-waiver-program.html)). For Canada, an eTA to fly in; none by land or sea ([GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/canada/entry-requirements)).
- **AU passports:**
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F038, F041, Project Lead (human)] Australia is in the Visa Waiver Program, so you need an ESTA before flying to the US, and an eTA to fly into Canada.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Check ESTA eligibility on the official US site before flying to the US, and check eTA rules on the official Canadian site before flying to Canada.

### Seasons at a glance
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F045, Project Lead (human)] Hawaii weddings run year-round. Most of the mainland and Canada favour May to October, and mountain winter weddings run December to March.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Hawaii, the mainland coasts, the mountains and Canada each run on different seasons. Tell us your month and we check weather, rates and availability for it.

sections.body_md:
## See how planning with us works
(anchor: #advisor)

Wedded Concierge pairs you with a Wedded Advisor who plans with you from the first enquiry to the last dance.

1. **Tell us where and when.** Share the place, month, guest count and style in the form below. Every enquiry goes to Wedded Concierge.
2. **Talk it through.** Your Wedded Advisor is your one contact: they explain your options, the legal route for your passports and what drives cost.
3. **Shortlist places and venues.** Together you narrow the region to a place, then to the venues that fit your guests.
4. **Sort the legal and travel steps.** We check the licence rules for your state or province and the entry rules for every passport in your group.
5. **Plan the guest experience.** Travel, rooms and a guest website so everyone knows where to be.

Wedded Privileges: ask your Wedded Advisor what the programme offers for your dates and hotel. [See how Wedded Concierge works](/wonderland-concierge).

faq.q: Where is the most popular wedding destination in the United States?
faq.a: Hawaii draws more searches than any other US wedding destination we track, but the right place depends on your style. For beaches, Maui, the Big Island or Kauai. For wine country, Napa and Sonoma. For mountains, Aspen, or Banff over the border in Canada. For Southern charm, Charleston or New Orleans. For cities, New York or Las Vegas.

faq.q: Should you marry in the USA, in Canada or further abroad?
faq.a: Choose the place most of your guests can reach easily. For a mostly American guest list, a US wedding means no travel authorisation, and Canada needs no tourist visa for stays under 180 days. For guests from Australia or the UK, both countries are long-haul and need travel authorisation before flying, so allow more planning time. [Travel by passport](#entry) sets out each step.

faq.q: Where can I get married with just the two of us?
faq.a: Hawaii is a strong choice for just the two of you: there is no residency rule, no waiting period once your licence is issued, and you both apply in person together. Kauai's cliffs, Big Sur's coast and the lakes of Banff suit a small ceremony too. Choose "Just the two of you" in the form and we plan around it.

faq.q: Is a destination wedding legal in the US?
faq.a: Yes, a wedding in the US is legal when you hold a marriage licence from the state where you marry and follow its rules. Each state sets its own. Hawaii, for example, has no state residence or US citizenship requirement, and the licence is valid only in Hawaii. UK citizens should also check the documents they need to show they are free to marry.

faq.q: Where in the US can you get married immediately?
faq.a: In Hawaii, there is no waiting period once your marriage licence is issued. You both still apply online and appear together in person, and you collect the licence no sooner than 30 days before the ceremony. Rules in other states differ, and we check them for your date.

faq.q: Do AU and UK guests need travel authorisation for the US or Canada?
faq.a:
UK guests need an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, or a visa, before travelling to the US, and an eTA to fly into Canada (last checked October 2026).
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F038, F041, Project Lead (human)] Australian guests also travel to the US on an ESTA under the Visa Waiver Program, and need an eTA to fly into Canada.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] Australian guests should check ESTA eligibility on the official US site and eTA rules on the official Canadian site before booking.
US guests need no authorisation to visit Canada for stays under 180 days.

faq.q: What is a realistic budget for a destination wedding in the USA?
faq.a: A realistic budget depends on four things: the place, the season, your guest count and how far your guests fly. Share your guest count and month in the form, and your Wedded Advisor talks you through what drives the cost for your plans.

faq.q: Why is a Hawaii wedding not usually all-inclusive?
faq.a: Most Hawaii weddings are built at luxury hotels that price the ceremony, dinner and rooms separately, rather than sold as one all-inclusive package. That gives you more choice over each part of the day, and it means the total depends on what you choose. We explain each line before you commit.

faq.q: When is the best time to marry in Hawaii, on the mainland and in Canada?
faq.a:
[APPLY AFTER SIGN-OFF: F045, Project Lead (human)] Hawaii suits weddings year-round, most of the mainland and Canada favour May to October, and mountain winter weddings run December to March.
[FALLBACK UNTIL THEN] The best month depends on where you marry, because Hawaii, the mainland coasts, the mountains and Canada each run on different seasons. Tell us your month and your Wedded Advisor checks weather, rates and availability for it.

faq.q: Can Wedded Wonderland plan a wedding in North America?
faq.a: Yes. Wedded Concierge plans weddings across the United States and Canada, from Hawaii to Banff. Your Wedded Advisor is your one contact for places, venues, legal steps and guest travel, and explains what Wedded Privileges offers for your dates.
